newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bank/Portugal seen leaving rates unchanged - poll.
newsitem.headline: Bank/Portugal seen leaving rates unchanged - poll.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal was expected to leave key rates unchanged on Tuesday on the eve of a new central bank reserve accounting period, seven economists polled by Reuters said.
All the economists said the central bank had room to cut rates further.
The Bank of Portugal is due to set money market conditions at 1415 GMT on Tuesday.
The repurchase pact rate is presently 6.50 percent and the absorption rate, used to drain funds from the money market, is 6.20 percent.
The poll was carried out today after the release of January inflation data.
The economists responded to the following questions.
1. Will the Bank of Portugal cut the repo rate?
No - 7.
Yes - 0.
2. If the answer to 1. is affirmative, by how much will the Bank of Portugal lower rates?
- Not applicable.
3. Will the Bank of Portugal cut the absorption rate this week?
No - 7.
Yes - 0.
4. If the answer to 3. is affirmative, by how much will the Bank of Portugal lower rates?
- Not applicable.
5. Is there room for further cuts in official rates?
Yes - 7.
No - 0.

The following companies took part in the poll: IMF-Informacao de Mercados Financeiros; Siemca-Sociedade Mediadora de Capitais; Banco Portugues de Investimento; Banco de Comercio e Industria; Banco Finantia; Banco Mello Investimentos; Fincor.
-- Fernanda Pargana, Lisbon newsroom, 351-1-3113126
